occupants.note: SEATED BY THE STREET-FACE ADOPTION POLICY (docs/STREET-FACE-ADOPTION.md, the owner's ruling of 2026-08-29 for T-0354, extended 2026-08-30 for T-0416; liberty L212). The newspaper register places this business on La Salle Street AND NOTHING NARROWER — 1 printing, 1835-06-10 to 1835-06-10, claims chicago_democrat_1835_06_10#c008 — so it takes the STREET FACE and not a lot. THE ROOF ENDS ITS PLATTED TIER AGAINST La Salle Street, so it is a corner building and stands on that street as well as on the one its lot faces — the owner's ruling of 2026-08-30 (T-0416). Nothing about the roof changed and no geometry was raised to seat this business. WHICH roof on that face it is given is an allocation by tools/adopt_street_faces.py and not a reading of any source, and nothing here says this business stood nearer the corner than any other on the same face. THE ROOF'S OWN EXISTENCE, POSITION AND FOOTPRINT REMAIN CONJECTURAL and are unchanged by the adoption: the business is documented, the building under it is not, and this attribute is graded `reconstructed` because the invented part is the whole of the placement.
